sources.name: MyNavyHR NAVADMIN
reserveSignals: TRAINING AND ADMINISTRATION OF THE RESERVE
sources.notes: Primary Navy message source. Monitor the yearly NAVADMIN index and inspect new messages for Reserve applicability, including Reserve officer board and APPLY announcements.

sources.name: MyNavyHR Reserve Officer Boards
sources.notes: Monitor the official Reserve Officer Boards landing page for new fiscal-year schedules, promotion-zone guidance, board-preparation changes, results-related links, phasing information, and other Reserve officer board updates.

sources.name: MyNavyHR Reserve Officer Continuation and Retention
sources.notes: Monitor Reserve officer continuation and retention rules, semiannual board dates, attrition windows, package deadlines, eligibility guidance, and linked board announcements.

sources.name: MyNavyHR Serving on a Reserve Board
sources.notes: Monitor the process and application links for serving on Navy Reserve officer, enlisted, special, spot-promotion, LDO/CWO, and command selection boards.

sources.name: Navy Reserve RESPERSMAN
sources.notes: Monitor RESPERSMAN index entries and linked chapter revisions for changed Reserve policy.

sources.name: Navy Reserve RESFOR Notices
sources.notes: Monitor official COMNAVRESFOR notices for Reserve policy, travel, training, readiness, pay, administrative changes, and APPLY board screening or assignment guidance.

sources.name: GovInfo Congressional Bills
sources.notes: Use official bill text/actions to verify legislative status. Do not mark legislation SIGNED or EFFECTIVE from third-party reporting.

sources.name: DFAS Military Pay Tables
sources.notes: Use for published active-duty and Reserve pay tables and official DFAS pay updates.

sources.name: VA Disability Compensation Rates
sources.notes: Use for final published VA compensation rates and official payment guidance.

sources.name: BLS Consumer Price Index
reserveSignals: CONSUMER PRICE INDEX FOR URBAN WAGE EARNERS AND CLERICAL WORKERS
sources.notes: Use CPI-W releases to track annual Social Security/VA COLA development. Do not publish a final COLA before the required quarter is complete.

sources.name: DoD Military Compensation
sources.notes: Use for DoD compensation and retirement policy references affecting Active and Reserve members.
